role: Tests that CloudKitSyncManager.defersForBackoff, the push batch's retry decision, lets every deferred session become eligible again within the ceiling, still backs off with more failures, spreads sessions across cycles, and that backoffPeriod doubles then stops at the ceiling and stableRetryBucket comes from the UUID's bytes.
types: CloudRetryProgressTests: class — XCTestCase for retry backoff progress
state: bucketOneUUID: private static UUID whose stableRetryBucket is 1

units.does: Asserts stableRetryBucket of the bucket-one UUID (first byte 0x01) is 1 and is the same on a second call.
